name: Clixon
what_it_is: Clixon is a YANG-based configuration manager providing interactive CLI, NETCONF, and RESTCONF interfaces with an embedded datastore and transaction mechanism. It is open source (Apache 2.0 or GPLv2) and designed for network device configuration management.
configuration: YANG models define the configuration schema
CLI auto-generated from YANG models via CLIgen
RESTCONF HTTP PUT/PATCH/GET/DELETE on yang-defined resources
Dual-datastore model: running and candidate configurations
constraints: No docker-compose file found in repository (neither master nor main branch) — no containerized sandbox definition available
Companion CLIgen library is a required external dependency for CLI functionality
YANG model must be authored before any configuration interface is available
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml in repository (404 on both master and main branches)
No built-in fault injection or chaos tooling documented
No native telemetry or streaming telemetry interface (e.g., gRPC/gNMI)
No authentication/authorization framework documented in README
No performance benchmarks or scalability constraints published
